WITH filtered_executions AS (
  SELECT 
    oe.ordersmark,
    o.orderflow,
    oe.fillcount
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  WHERE oe.expirespot > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' 
    AND oe.expirespot < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
),
group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(fillcount) as avg_fillcount
  FROM filtered_executions
  GROUP BY ordersmark, orderflow
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as result
FROM group_averages
